findings.text: Upheld as advisory (Q10/Q11). The doc comment says 'api.ts re-exports the type', but ui/src/api.ts only imports it. The comment says something the code does not do. Either add the re-export or drop the clause. (The reviewer placed this at file line 12. In the current file the comment is on line 6.)

Upheld as advisory (Q5/Q6). releaseStatus spots a report that could not be built by matching the server's literal prefix 'not checked: ' (NOT_BUILT, from src/ui/update.ts). The two files are tied by a string the type does not carry. A field in ViewerUpdate would carry that fact instead.

Upheld as advisory (Q2). The 'failed' predicate rewrites lastFailed from src/update/state.ts on the client. It is one expression, and state.ts loads node:fs, so the browser cannot import it. The server could send the fact instead.

Upheld as advisory (Q3). The 'daily' switch reads on whenever the value is not 'off'. With an unknown value (mode off-unknown) the switch shows on while no check runs. Reading updateState's mode would make them agree.

Upheld as advisory (Q2). ViewerUpdate is declared on the server here and again on the client in ui/src/update.ts, and nothing keeps the two in step. The client also spells Mode out instead of importing it from the leaf src/update/mode.ts.

Upheld as advisory (rubric Q5, as the reviewer files it). AC-8's case where the builder throws calls viewerUpdate directly, so neither the route nor the 200 status is checked through /api/update. The test still fails if the catch is reverted.
Upheld as advisory. fetch is wrapped only after start({}) has returned, so a check made at viewer startup would go unseen. The criterion's wording (the two routes) is met.
Upheld as advisory. The import walk reuses a regex that matches only quoted specifiers, so a template-literal dynamic import would not be followed. The positive controls show the walk itself is real.
Upheld as advisory. The expected status text is built with the same capitalise formula the code uses, so the test mirrors the implementation. The tones are literals and fail on reversion.
Upheld as advisory. No test exercises agentsNote. AC-11 does not list the agents line, so this is not a defect.

Upheld as advisory. GET /api/update can return the first line of an error and the staged binary's absolute path, and either may contain home-directory paths. The audience does not change: the route is behind the Host and token checks on the loopback-only server, and status/doctor already print the same lines to the same person. The text is rendered as plain Vue text, never as HTML. This is not a broader exposure.

Upheld as a defect (Q2: an undeclared reachable branch). The finding was filed at spec.md:30, which is not a line of this gate's diff. It is placed at the diff lines the finding itself names. The Screens line of spec.md:30 declares six About states plus update-out, but the diff reaches more branches, and AC-11 names every one of them. They are: the warning tone for a report that could not be built (ui/src/update.ts:52); the muted tone for off-unknown and ci (ui/src/update.ts:53); the quiet tone for 'ahead' (ui/src/update.ts:57); and the banner's 'This copy is <running>.' line when no copy is staged (ui/src/update.ts:33). None is declared or captured. A capture cannot show a missing declaration, so this rests on the diff lines. Fix: declare these states in the spec's Screens line and capture them.

Lowered to advisory (judge's evidence rule). The reviewer's defect: in memories-update-out@360-dark.png and @360-light.png, only the icon and 'How to' show. '0.9.0 is out.' and Dismiss are past the right edge, because main sits beside the 216px projects sidebar, which stays open. Looking at review/ui/memories-update-out@360-dark.png confirms this, and it contradicts the manifest note 'uncut beside the two actions'. It cannot be upheld as a defect because review/ui-evidence.json, the engine's manifest, is absent. These captures are listed only in a session-written review/ui/manifest.json. An overflow is exactly what a capture shows, so the diff-line branch does not apply either. The root cause is ui/src/App.vue:165 (the existing sidebar, outside the change). To be decided on engine-recorded evidence in the next round.
Upheld as advisory. At 768 the full line truncates through the staged version ('The agents run 0…'). The spec allows a line that truncates (memories-update-out@768-dark.png, @768-light.png).

Upheld as advisory. The agents line repeats the agents' version from the status line and prints the staged binary's full temporary path, which takes four lines at 360 (settings-about-out@1280-dark.png, settings-about-out@360-light.png). The text comes from src/update/report.ts.
Upheld as advisory. break-all splits the shell commands in the middle of words at every width. The copy button means nothing is lost (settings-about-out@1280-dark.png, @768-dark.png, @360-dark.png).

Upheld as advisory. The warning tone uses the same upgrade-arrow icon for 'a release is out' and 'Could not check', so a failed check shows the wrong signal (settings-about-failed@1280-dark.png, @1280-light.png).
Upheld as advisory (Q5, copy). The off-env status line uses the terminal's wording ('this command's environment') inside the viewer (settings-about-off-env@1280-dark.png, @360-light.png).
Upheld as advisory. The channel names 'plugin' and 'script' are lowercase next to Homebrew and npm, and the plugin instruction starts lowercase (settings-about-out@1280-light.png).
Upheld as advisory. At 360 each copy button wraps under its command, so four rows become twelve. Crowding that still holds (settings-about-out@360-dark.png, @360-light.png).

Advisory, debt (outside the change). The 216px projects sidebar stays open at 768 and 360, which squeezes main. This is the cause underneath the 360 banner overflow (memories-update-out@768-dark.png, @360-dark.png).
Advisory, debt (outside the change). In the light scheme the off track of USwitch is barely visible on white cards, across every switch in Settings (settings-about-off@1280-light.png).
